name: Benzyl glycidyl ether
description: Benzyl glycidyl ether (CAS 2930-05-4 ) is a reactive epoxy monomer used to modify and extend epoxy resin systems across industrial manufacturing. It functions as a reactive diluent, reducing viscosity in uncured formulations. The compound incorporates into the cured polymer network rather than remaining as a free plasticizer. In electronics, it is used in encapsulants and underfill compounds where controlled flow and low viscosity are critical before cure. Structural adhesives and sealants for automotive and aerospace assemblies use it to improve processability. This allows for better application without sacrificing crosslink density in the final bond during the curing process. Coating formulators incorporate it into high-solids and solvent-reduced epoxy coatings. This helps to meet specific application viscosity targets for industrial spray or brush application methods in various settings. It also serves as a building block in specialty polymer synthesis where a pendant benzyloxy group is required. This is essential for downstream functionalization or specific chain modification in chemical manufacturing. Benzyl glycidyl ether is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering, with purity specifications typically at 98% or higher confirmed by GC analysis. The product is available in drum and IBC quantities suited to industrial formulation volumes.
